resources.string: During your chosen protection period, returns Home from gambling apps, VPN apps, Tor apps, VPN browsers, their install pages and the taps that would switch SafeNest off.

After your separate consent, SafeNest reads the foreground app package ID, supported browser address bars and the labels of Android Settings, app-installer and Play Store screens. During an active protection period you chose and paid for, it returns Home from gambling apps, VPN apps, Tor apps and browsers with a built-in VPN, and from their install pages; a supported browser steps back from a blocked website, including one opened by IP address. SafeNest\'s own Settings pages stay open; tapping Uninstall, Force stop, Clear storage, Forget VPN or turning Always-on VPN off returns Home. SafeNest never reads page content, messages, passwords, keyboard input or notification content, and nothing it observes is recorded or uploaded. Website filtering uses the separate local DNS service. There is no in-app pause during the finite commitment; it ends automatically at expiry, and Android Safe Mode, a factory reset or a computer can still remove the app.
